description: "Is my car seat recalled?" deserves a better answer than "go search two government sites." Recall Scout puts the NHTSA and CPSC recall databases inside your assistant - vehicles, tires, child car seats, equipment, and consumer products, refreshed daily. Every answer carries the hazard, the remedy, and the official recall link, so you can act on it instead of just worrying about it. Honest boundary: food, drug, and medical-device recalls (FDA) are not covered, and the tool says so. Free to use. Built and run by SimonBuilds.
